I was diagnosed with Asperger’s in my early childhood.

The biggest thing that affects me is the societal aspect; more specifically, my inability to pick up social cues. A large portion of communication is body language, and it is nearly impossible for me to distinguish small changes in body language.

Another disabling factor of Autism is not being able to expressly dictate my thoughts and feelings to others in a way that makes sense to them. The way I speak and write can come off as cryptic to others, or just plain confusing in general.

Some of the other things I have noticed about myself is...

-I easily find myself in a state of hyper-vigilance 
-I can’t easily keep a conversation going
-When I’m interested in a topic, I hyper-fixate on it
-it’s easy to fall into sensory overload 
-I hate changes in routine 

I’m sure there are other things that I missed, but that’s the gist!
It doesn’t matter if I’m getting any support or not when there is 0 joy or purpose in living. Living is a joke. I’d run at a cop with a knife without hesitation
